# Scheduler and Gantt change events lose their `source` to the sender id

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs. The work is a rename in four files with one spec, the context below is public, and nothing waits on it: the key it adds is new, so it can land after the Engine 14 cut.

## Context

Found while reviewing #21643. That example's status line is meant to say when an edit came from the keyboard, and it never does. A listener added in the app worker with `scheduler.on('eventChange', …)` shows why: for an `ArrowRight` move the payload arrives with `source: 'neo-scheduler-1'`.

- Observed (Chromium, PR head `8972422a61`; the engine files named below are the same on `dev`): `action/source` = `move/neo-scheduler-1`.
- What the emitter writes: `move/keyboard`.

## The Problem

`Neo.core.Observable#fire` writes the sender's id into `source` of every object payload. Four emitters under `src` put a `source` of their own into that payload, and each loses it:

| Emitter | Event | What the emitter writes | What a listener gets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src/scheduler/Container.mjs:1043` | `eventChange` | `meta.source \|\| 'api'` (`'keyboard'` at `:1227` and `:1234`) | the scheduler's id |
| `src/gantt/Container.mjs:937` | `taskChange` | `meta.source \|\| 'api'` (`:948`) | the Gantt's id |
| `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs:2470` | `beforeDockZoneDocumentChange` | the projection's `source` | the workspace's id |
| `src/form/field/chip/ValueList.mjs:252` | `removevalue` | the instance (`source: this`) | its id |

The first two are the only way an app can tell a keyboard edit, a drag and an API call apart, and both components are new in Engine 14. No listener in the engine reads `source` from the last two (`src/dashboard/dock/plugin/Maximize.mjs:245`, `src/form/field/Chip.mjs:567`).

The count: a scan of the 570 tracked `.mjs` files under `src` finds 190 `fire('name', {…})` calls with an object literal, 4 of them with a `source` key of their own. The scan reads literal payloads only; a payload built in a variable is not covered.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/core/Observable.mjs:275-278`: "Object event format. Inject firer reference in as 'source'", then `args[0].source = me.id`. Listeners across the engine rely on that, so `source` is a reserved key of an object payload.
- `src/scheduler/Container.mjs:891` documents `@param {String} [meta.source='api']` on `moveEvent`, the single writer, and `:1051` copies it into the payload.
- `src/gantt/Container.mjs:948` does the same for `taskChange`. The Gantt also reads `meta.source` before it fires (`:378`, `:713`, `:772`, `:782`); those reads are unaffected.
- `learn/guides/datahandling/Scheduler.md:131-135` and `learn/guides/datahandling/Gantt.md:66` show the listeners and name no `source`.
- Design authority: `@param {String} [meta.source='api']` (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs:891`) together with `source    : meta.source || 'api'` (`:1051`): the emitter intends a listener to read where an edit came from.

## The Fix

1. `eventChange` and `taskChange` carry the edit's origin under a key `fire` does not reserve. Proposed name: `changeSource`. The input stays `meta.source`. The JSDoc of both writers and the listener paragraph of both guides name the key.
2. `removevalue` and `beforeDockZoneDocumentChange` drop their own `source`: nobody reads it and the injected id already names the sender. Check the specs that listen to the dock event (`test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockMaximizePlugin.spec.mjs`, `DockWorkspaceSetTransaction.spec.mjs`, `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockHeavyContentSplitNL.spec.mjs`) before removing it.
3. One unit spec scans `src` for an object-literal `fire` payload that declares `source` and fails on a hit, so the collision cannot come back unnoticed.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.scheduler.Container` `eventChange` payload | `moveEvent` JSDoc, `:891` and `:1051` | `changeSource` holds `'keyboard'`, `'api'` or the caller's `meta.source`; `source` stays the sender's id | none: the old key never delivered its value | `learn/guides/datahandling/Scheduler.md` | unit spec: the listener of a keyboard move reads `'keyboard'` |
| `Neo.gantt.Container` `taskChange` payload | `:948` | the same key | none, same reason | `learn/guides/datahandling/Gantt.md` | unit spec |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A listener of `eventChange` reads `changeSource: 'keyboard'` for an `ArrowRight` move and for a `Shift+ArrowRight` resize, and `'api'` for a bare `moveEvent(...)` call. `source` is the scheduler's id each time.
- [ ] The same holds for `taskChange` on the Gantt.
- [ ] No object-literal `fire` payload under `src` declares `source`, and a unit spec fails when one does.
- [ ] Both guides name the key in their listener paragraph.

## Out of Scope

A change to `Observable#fire`. Payloads built outside an object literal. The example of #21643, which drops its dead branch in its own review.

## Avoided Traps

- **Letting `fire` keep a `source` the payload already has.** Listeners read `source` as the sender's id everywhere; an event that answered with something else would break that for its own listeners only.
